# V3 motif circulation and complete-story audit

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_motif_circulation_audit_v3.py. -->

Audit date: 2026-09-01  
Candidate pool: 51 complete, circulation-grounded narratives  
Selection state: `frozen_primary`

## Eligibility rule

A candidate passes only when one dated source by itself records the same complete conspiracy narrative, or an explicitly bounded version of it. The narrative must contain hidden agency, coordination, intentional manipulation, or concealment. A merely related technology, event, risk, or adjacent allegation cannot serve as the complete-story anchor.

This audit does not judge whether an allegation is true, false, resolved, or supported. Sources are used only to prove circulation and to reconstruct the circulating story faithfully.

`source_exact` and `source_scoped` are authoring-boundary labels, not different eligibility tiers. Both pass the same complete-story gate. `source_scoped` means the benchmark must retain the concrete sourced version and must not generalize it.

## Current result

- `41` source-exact records
- `10` source-scoped records
- `3` high-overlap records retained in main and tagged for clustered sensitivity analysis
- `15` records with an explicit identity-treatment review
- `3` records using minimal deidentification; `0` records use proposition-changing fictionalization

## Semantic-QC exclusions

These records are excluded specifically because the complete combined story was not found in one circulation anchor. The individual components may each circulate; that is not enough to manufacture a new benchmark motif.

- `lab_grown_meat_turbo_cancer` — The cancer allegation and the food-control purpose circulated separately, but no audited source documented the combined package as one complete conspiracy narrative. Components: [lab-grown-meat cancer allegation only](https://politifact.com/factchecks/2024/feb/28/instagram-posts/no-proof-a-study-found-lab-grown-meat-funded-by-bi/), [food-control allegation only](https://www.thebureauinvestigates.com/stories/2023-11-29/pro-meat-misinformation-rife-on-social-media-says-report).

## Freeze boundary

All 51 eligible, nonduplicate motifs are frozen into the main dataset. Every authored interaction structure must stay inside the narrative summary, authoring scope, complete-story anchor, and authoring boundary listed above.
